units.source_scale_reason: Guides are the accepted paintings at their accepted scale; every video frame keeps one fixed extraction scale and anchor.

visual_review.notes: Reviewed every take by contact strip. Every take is a first take. The hit rears, roars and crashes back to the stance before its dark plates begin; the walk loops video 24-85 every second frame, where the seam is smoothest, and swings the tail out and back with each stride.
